title: Alberta Scanned 466 Million Lines of Code With Claude in 20 Hours
description:
Anthropic published a case study on July 6 showing how Alberta's government used Claude Code to secure its systems.
It's the first Canadian provincial government to publish this kind of AI cybersecurity case study.
Follow for daily AI news.
